title: Zelensky Says Ukraine 'Ready' for Energy Ceasefire After Trump Meeting at UN
detail: September 22, 2026 — Volodymyr Zelensky met Donald Trump in New York on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly's high-level debate. Zelensky told reporters afterward that Ukraine is 'ready for any kind of format of energy ceasefire' — a mutual halt to strikes on oil, gas and diesel infrastructure — provided Russia commits to the same truce. The leaders also discussed winter support for Ukraine, licensing for Patriot air-defense production, and a possible trilateral meeting with Vladimir Putin, floated for the G20 summit in Miami. Trump called the US-Ukraine relationship 'very strong.' No date or venue for trilateral talks was confirmed, and Russia has not responded publicly to the energy-ceasefire proposal.

title: US Withholds Burhan's UN Visa Over Rejected 90-Day Sudan Ceasefire Plan
detail: September 22, 2026 — Sources said the United States is withholding a visa for Sudanese army chief and Sovereignty Council head Abdel Fattah al-Burhan ahead of his scheduled UN General Assembly address (originally set for Sep 26), tying issuance to Burhan accepting a 90-day ceasefire proposed by US Senior Advisor for Arab and African Affairs Massad Boulos. Burhan rejected the take-it-or-leave-it framing; Sudan's army had already voiced reservations about the Boulos plan in July. Sudan's UN Ambassador Al-Harith Idriss Al-Harith wrote to Secretary-General Guterres on Sep 21 requesting 'immediate intervention' with US authorities, calling the withholding a violation of UN convention and international law. A senior Sudanese source said Burhan postponed his New York trip; Foreign Minister Mohieldin Salem is expected to address the Assembly in his place.

title: Trump and Venezuela's Rodríguez Hold First Meeting Since Maduro's Capture
detail: September 22, 2026 — Donald Trump and Venezuelan interim President Delcy Rodríguez held an informal pull-aside meeting in New York on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly — their first face-to-face encounter since US forces captured Nicolás Maduro in a January 2026 raid; Maduro remains jailed in New York on federal drug-trafficking charges. Rodríguez's delegation, which included Venezuela's economy vice president, oil minister and PDVSA officials, focused on making the country 'investable,' meeting separately with the IMF, World Bank and Inter-American Development Bank. Rodríguez said the two sides discussed 'strengthening the bilateral relationship' and a cooperation agenda spanning energy, mining and security. The meeting runs parallel to the Caracas government-opposition dialogue track, which held its second round of talks on Sep 17-18.

title: Erdoğan Tells UN Gaza's Second Ceasefire Phase Is Stalled as Israel 'Refuses to Stop the Killing'
detail: September 22, 2026 — Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan told the UN General Assembly's high-level debate that Israel 'refuses to stop the killing in Gaza and move to the second phase of the Trump plan,' calling Gaza 'the most inhumane, most shameful concentration camp of our time' and citing over 74,000 Palestinians killed over three years, including more than 1,500 since the October 2025 ceasefire, and roughly 70% of hospital generators non-functional from fuel shortages. He called for stronger international pressure on Israel, renewed recognition of Palestinian statehood, and UN Security Council reform. The Israeli delegation, led by envoy Danny Danon, walked out during the speech. The remarks underscore the gap between the Board of Peace's stalled implementation roadmap and conditions on the ground nearly a year into the ceasefire.
